description: A DIRECTORY of feed URLs to fetch with your own web tools, per sector and per ticker. It returns no headlines and stores no articles. For ready-made clustered headlines, call get_market_news instead.

sector.description: Which news sector. Omit for the full index of all sectors.

symbols.description: Yahoo tickers to build per-ticker headline feeds for (e.g. ['XOM','CVX']). Overrides the sector's default universe; capped at 50.

name: get_news_sources
